title: Free literals of a restricted term
statement: Given a DNF term $T$ on $n$ coordinates and a coordinate restriction $ho$, the free restriction of $T$ is the term consisting of precisely those literals of $T$ whose coordinates are left free by $ho$.
hypotheses_covered: DNF term T on n coordinates
